jobs.title: ArcGis Developer
jobs.description:
Job Title: ArcGis DeveloperJob Category: Information TechnologyTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: SecretEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%Type of Travel: Continental US\* \* \*

**The Opportunity:**  
We are seeking an ArcGIS Developer to support the Joint Transportation Management System (JTMS) program. The ideal candidate will work with geospatial technologies and ArcGIS platforms to develop, maintain, and enhance transportation and logistics visualization capabilities. This position offers an excellent opportunity for a developing professional to gain hands-on experience with enterprise GIS solutions in support of critical defense operations.

  

Job Description:

The JTMS ArcGIS Developer will work as part of a dynamic team responsible for designing, developing, and implementing geospatial solutions that support transportation management and logistics operations. This role involves working with ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Online, and related ESRI technologies to create maps, applications, and analytical tools that enhance situational awareness and decision-making capabilities.  
  
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* • Develop and maintain web-based mapping applications using ArcGIS JavaScript API, Web AppBuilder, and Experience Builder • Create and manage geospatial data, feature services, and map services in ArcGIS Enterprise environments • Support the integration of JTMS data with ArcGIS platforms for visualization and analysis • Perform quality assurance and testing of GIS applications and data • Assist in the development of custom geoprocessing tools and workflows • Provide technical documentation for developed applications and processes • Collaborate with senior developers, system administrators, and end-users to gather requirements and deliver solutions • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to GIS applications and services • Stay current with ArcGIS platform updates and emerging geospatial technologies
  

**Qualifications:**  
  
*Required:*

* Active Secret Clearance
* Bachelor's degree in Geography, Geographic Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field
* 1-2 years of experience with ArcGIS Desktop, ArcGIS Pro, or ArcGIS Online
* Basic understanding of ArcGIS Enterprise architecture and components
* Familiarity with web development technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
* Knowledge of geospatial data formats and coordinate systems
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
* Excellent communication and teamwork abilities
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, mission-critical environment
  

*Desired:*

* Experience with ArcGIS JavaScript API or Python for ArcGIS
* Knowledge of REST APIs and web services
* Familiarity with SQL and database concepts
* Working knowledge and experience with SAP S4 HANA
* Agile SAFe experience
* Understanding of transportation or logistics systems
* ESRI Technical Certification

This position is contingent on funding and may not be filled immediately. However, this position is representative of positions within CACI that are consistently available. Individuals who apply may also be considered for other positions at CACI.  
  

**What You Can Expect:**

**A culture of integrity.**

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

**An environment of trust.**

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

**A focus on continuous growth.**

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

  
  

**Pay Range** :

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.

The proposed salary range for this position is:

$58,000-$115,900

*CACI is* *an Equal Opportunity Employer.* *All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any* *other protected characteristic.*
